name: Urban Institute — State of the Safety Net 2025
fetch_notes: apps.urban.org accepts curl with a browser User-Agent; datacatalog.urban.org returns 403.

model.name: ATTIS
model.method: Simulates program eligibility on pooled 2022+2023 ACS (2.7M households, adjusted to 2023). Participation rate = actual administrative caseload / simulated eligible count; the numerator is admin data, not simulation. Estimates refer to the average month of 2023.

funders_note: Funders include the Pritzker Children's Initiative (also a PolicyEngine funder), Annie E. Casey, and Packard.
diagnosis_upstream: ATTIS is closed-source; divergence diagnoses classified as external-model issues become a comparison memo, not an upstream PR.
